title: 5 big analyst AI moves: Downgrades for SAP and Intuit; AMD lifted to Strong Buy
body: JPMorgan and Bank of America cut Intuit to Neutral, slash price targets on weaker FY27 outlook and rising TurboTax, QuickBooks competition

questions.question: What number changed versus what was already priced?
questions.note: Price target slashed from $605 to $331, reflecting downgrade to Neutral and weaker FY27 outlook due to AI-driven competitive pressures (TurboTax/QuickBooks).

questions.question: Is this one named issuer, or a factor that should not be pinned to a camera ticker?
questions.note: This is a named issuer (Intuit), not a factor.

questions.question: If guidance was only reaffirmed, why is an up call illegal?
questions.note: Guidance was not reaffirmed; it was explicitly weakened (FY27 outlook downgraded) with a price target cut, making an up call illegal.

instruments.lane_why: Mentioned explicitly in the title and body of the article as 'Intuit' with no ambiguity.
